question: Do Fr 10370's number-bearing photograph and the indexed IV.156 folio 8 description support the same original k-II page?
prior_exposure: The fragment, red marks, institutional catalogue description, first source line and candidate chant were already seen before this protocol. This is a post-exposure test, not a blinded or independent reading.
candidate_premises: The Swedish II-like sign and the Finnish indexed ij refer to the same unique k-II address.
The numeric-sign photograph shows the opening of the same original recto as the described Finnish folio 8 opening.
The catalogue's indexed opening words and the provisional Swedish reading faithfully describe the underlying pages.
predictions: If the premises are all correct and both observations concern the same opening, the top-of-page text should agree. If it differs, at least one premise or the same-page hypothesis needs revision; a source-description error, damaged/cropped text, repeat or reset numbering, side convention, or composite structure is an alternative.
scope: Do not promote an indexed Finnish text to an inspected original. Do not equate an open-book signature with an automatically unique leaf ID, or transfer a conditional f.8 conflict to the separate Fr8994 f.9 boundary or whole Codex1505 group.
